answer_1.quote: We investigate four conditional text generation tasks, ranging from more precision-oriented tasks like machine translation to more open-ended tasks like commonsense generation and question generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated questions, commonsense sentences, summaries, translations

answer_2.quote: We measure the generated outputs from multiple aspects including text quality, relevance, diversity, 3. Text quality: we adopted two relevance based metrics, ROUGE (R1, R2, RL) and METEOR (MTR), for assessing the surface similarity between the generated strings and the reference. 4. Naturalness: We measure the naturalness of the generated sequences with MAUVE, a metric for open-ended text generation.
